title: Web crawler pipeline
purpose: Replace ambiguous source flow with explicit unique-content and unseen-URL branches, DNS-assisted fetching and discovery feedback.
alt: 웹 크롤러의 미수집 URL·HTML 다운로드·중복 콘텐츠 검증·링크 추출·URL 중복 검사와 재투입 흐름
requiredChecks: Seed URLs→URL frontier→HTML downloader→Parser/validator→Content duplicate check in order; DNS resolver is a side dependency of downloader.
Duplicate-content Yes discards; No both stores Content storage and continues to URL extractor→URL filter→Seen URL check.
Seen URL Yes discards, while No records URL in Seen/queued URL store and enqueues in URL frontier.
Content storage and Seen/queued URL store are separate; feedback arrow joins frontier, not downloader/parser.
Labels and Yes/No branch directions are legible; no DNS forwards HTML or duplicate URLs endlessly loop.
prompt: Create a NEW original raster system-design diagram for a technical blog. English labels, large navy sans-serif text on white, flat blue/teal cards, clear numbered or labelled arrows with empty routing gutters. No logos, copied textbook composition or guarantee of exactly-once delivery. TITLE "Web crawler pipeline". Use wide two-row loopdiagram. TOProwleft→right "Seed URLs"→"URL frontier"→"HTML downloader"→"Parser / validator"→diamond "Duplicate content?". Small "DNS resolver" ABOVEdownloader connects ONLYwithdownloader by doubleheadedarrow "Resolve host". Yesbranchfromcontentdiamond upwardto small "Discard duplicate"; Nobranchdownward into shortclearjunction: one arrow "Store" to separate "Content storage" card, anotherarrowlabel"New content" downinto BOTTOMrow rightmost "URL extractor". BOTTOMrow proceeds RIGHT→LEFT: "URL extractor"→"URL filter"→diamond "Seen / queued URL?". Explainright-to-leftflowwithcleararrowheads. Yesbranchdownfromseendiamond to "Discard URL". Nobranchleftinto separate "Record URL" processcard; thiscard points DOWNto "Seen / queued URL store", and also a left/up outergutterarrow labelled "Enqueue new URL" backtoURLfrontier. Seendiamond has dottedquerylinktoSeenstore ifroutingreadable. No branch must be ambiguity betweenStoreandEnqueue: both happen fornewURL. Footer "Separate content deduplication from URL deduplication". Original independentlayout, generousmargin for loop, no falseDNSHTMLtransit. Use simplecards insteadofbusyicons.
